segments.text: ایدرا سیچچے آئیم سروڑا سروپ ویمارش آبیشتا ہے.
سچا یوجی is always sitting and residing in his own nature, in his own real nature.
سروپ ویمارش آبیشتا ہے.
In the consciousness of his nature, he is always residing in his consciousness of nature
for him Narataka Atma, the dancer in this field of universal dance.
Do you know what universal dance is?
Discretion.
Recreation, going birth, death, joy, sadness, depression, joy, enjoyment, everything, whatever you experience in your life.
That is the dance, that is the drama.
In that drama, in that field of drama, the dancer is your own nature.
Narataka Atma, the one who dances in this field of drama, drama of universal drama.
Universal drama is drama for those who are aware of it,
who are not aware, they are played in drama, they are played in drama.
So, they get sadness, they get enjoyment, they get joy, they get excitement, they get depression.
But those who are aware, they are always highly elevated.
Those who are spectators, by spectating, you must know that awareness is spectating.
And you are aware of that.
The dancer is your own self there in that drama of universe.
Naritati, antar, viku, hit, sosuru, pavashtam, muulam, tatat, jagara, dinana, buhmi ka, prapancham.
Soperi, spandh, lile, hai, sabita, prakati, iti, iti narataka Atma.
Your own self of universal consciousness is in fact dancer, because he dances.
The dancing, what dancing means, he puts forth that explanation.
Antar viku, hit, sosuru, pavashtam, muulam.
The dancer is that who conceals his real nature.
When you conceal your real nature of your being and reveal another formation of your being to public,
that is dancer, that is the way of dancing.
Because when Muhammad but is the real dancer and he appears as Lord Krishna, he appears as Lord Shiva,
he appears as a woman, he appears as a child, he appears as a silly fellow in drama.
So the real actual state of his being is concealed, where actual state of his being is concealed
and superficial formation is revealed.
That is antar, negu, hit, sosuru, pavashtam, muulam.
But it is concealed for others, not for him.
He knows that he is Muhammad but he is aware of his being Muhammad but at the time of becoming Lord Krishna or Shiva or Muhammad.
He knows that he is really Muhammad but in himself.
He is conscious, he is aware of yes, I don't know what to say.
I have forgotten by these actions because my connection of awareness was disconnected.
How can I remember what I had to say?
Dance, sir.
So antar, negu, hit, sosuru, pavashtam, muulam.
In fact, he knows that he is that fellow.
Tattat jagarajanana, buhmi ka prapankam.
Actually he is filled with that awareness of universal God consciousness and he appears in waking state.
He appears sometime, I mean Lord Shiva.
Lord Shiva is the dancer and he appears in wakefulness, he appears in dreaming state.
He appears sometimes in dreamless state, sushvati and so on.
So perispandali layav sabita prakati ethi in itinar taka.
But he actually is playing like that.
Actually this is his play.
It is not his real action.
Real action is his being in his own universal God consciousness.
Each and every, in each and every diversion of revealing his nature, revealing his formation,
differentiated formation.
At the time of revealing, he is differentiated formation in volumes that state of jagrat, wakefulness.
There is diversion.
He diverts his universal consciousness in the state of wakefulness.
And at that state also, he finds that he is playing.
Actually this is play, this is not, he has not becoming.
He has not become, although he has become, but he has not actually become jagrat.
He has not actually become sopna, or he has not actually become sushvati.
He is already there in that universal God consciousness.
So this is the play.
So this is what is called nartaka, the dancer.
This is the way of dancer.
Tadokhtam Sri Naisas Devi, Maheshara Nartaka, Saptam Patle, Devi Krtasthave.
It is the stotra, hymns composed by Devi.
In Naisas Devi, Maheshara Nartaka, in tantras, in seventh chapter.
Tadokhtam Sri Nantarathma, Nartaka Koshrakshta.
In one way, O Lord Shiva, you are antarathma, you are actually residing in your own nature.
But Koshrakshta, but your coverings are different.
You have put another covering, one way of covering and appears that universal God consciousness appears as wakefulness.
Another way of covering is put there, and you find that universal consciousness is not there.
It is the state of dreaming, dreaming state, and it is the state of dreamless state and so on.
Bhattana Rai Nainapin, Bhattana Rai Nain also has said in his Shastra stavajantamani.
Visrista, Seshisat, Bhij, Garbham, Trilo, Kenaatakam, Prastave, Hare Samharthum, Tattakonya, Kavikshma.
O Lord Shiva, you have this whole, the germ of universal existence.
This germ of universal existence is existing in your own self, this germ of universal existence.
So, from you, this universe has expanded outside.
The germ is there, the bea, the seed, and this is trilo-kenaatakam.
This is from that seed you create the drama of three worlds, drama of Jagrath, drama of Sopun, drama of Sushanti.
You create three ways of dramas, from that point of that seed, which is residing already in your real nature.
Prastave, Hare Samharthum, Tattakonya, Kavikno.
Who else can do such acting to just create this drama and to withdraw it?
Prastave means just to create it and Samharthum is just to withdraw it again.
You create this drama and you withdraw it again.
It is the only way of your action of awareness.
Prastave, Hare, O Lord, Hare is Amantranam, Amantranam Padam Yadam.
Hare is Amantranam, Sambhaudam. Understand?
Samnitya.
Sarvagamu Uparijadi Shri Prithvigaya.
The Prithvigaya also says, the Prithvigya Shastra also says the same thing, which is the secret of all tantras.
The Prithvigaya, the way of recognition, is the secret of all tantras.
In that also it is said, samsara naitipravarta yata, the creator of the drama of universe.
The creator of the drama of universe is only in this universe filled with awareness.
In this unaware world, Sopthaya Jagati, in the world which is that is absolutely unaware of what is being, what is existing in this universe.
In this unaware world, the awareness only is held by you O Lord.
Because you are the creator of the drama of universe.
And you are unique, who is actually faithful in dreaming state.

This covering has no meaning, covering of wakefulness, covering of dreaming and covering of dreamless.
It has no meaning.
The meaning is only in the meaning only exists in that universe of God consciousness.
He is God in this.
He is God in this.
Protecting this for the time being.

So it is already explained in previous lecture, lecture that this whole universe is drama.
It is actually a big universal drama taking place.
And the hero that plays part of Dehran is Antaratma, internal soul, not external one.
There are three kinds of souls.
One is the internal soul, one is external soul and one is universal soul.
Universal soul is not the player.
Internal soul is the player, not external soul.
Internal soul is the positive one.
Pristaka, Sukshma, that soul who resides in dreaming state, that soul who resides after death.
That is the internal soul.
This soul which is in this body is external soul.
He is not the player in this drama of universe.
Actually that internal soul is also universal soul, but in this guys.
So such a yogi has become the dancer in the drama of universal field.
